E0307

`if`/multi-head dispatch not exhaustive (lists missing)

What

`if`/multi-head dispatch not exhaustive (lists missing)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0307

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0307: tests/ui/dispatch_not_exhaustive.stderr.

Error [E0307]: this `if` doesn't cover every case — missing: Green
  --> tests/ui/dispatch_not_exhaustive.jet:8:5
    |
  8 |     if x == {
    |     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: every arm here is a pattern test, so each variant must appear once
 Fix: add an arm for: Green
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0307

Error [E0116]: `print` doesn't hand back a value
  --> tests/ui/dispatch_not_exhaustive.jet:10:13
    |
 10 |             print("r")
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: a call is a value only when its function declares a result after the parameter list
 Fix: inside an arm, wrap the call in `{ … }`; otherwise put `print` on its own line, or declare it as `fn print(…) Type -> …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0116
